title: Hardy Persistence
description:
You have followed your Yurta on its long winter migrations, from one mountain pass to the next.

The first time you {{memorisee|memorise}} {{PERRUS-001|this Skill}}, choose an {{aptitude}} from {{survie}}, {{athletisme}} and {{perception}}. While {{PERRUS-001|this Skill}} is {{memorisee}}, you have {{expertise}} in that {{aptitude}}.
